title: Softening risk appetite weighs on market
section_path: Softening risk appetite weighs on market
section_path_text: Softening risk appetite weighs on market
summary:
Main
Rising attacks in the Middle East pushed the energy sector higher. AI-related stock selloff weighed on risk appetite across the rest of the complex. By Daniel Hynes
Image reference: Στιγμιότυπο οθόνης 2026-10-23 112248.png | assets/2026-10-23_softening-risk-appetite-weighs-on-market_img_cea3cf84ceb9ceb3cebcceb9cf8ccf84cf85_baa98bb2001a.png

Market Commentary
Crude oil pushed higher, as rising hostilities in the Middle East raised concerns of further supply disruptions.

children.summary: Rising attacks in the Middle East pushed the energy sector higher. AI-related stock selloff weighed on risk appetite across the rest of the complex.

children.title: Market Commentary
children.summary: Crude oil pushed higher, as rising hostilities in the Middle East raised concerns of further supply disruptions. A drone attack on Saudi Aramco's Shaybah field killed two people, as the Yemen-based Houthis continue attacks on the kingdom.

children.title: Chart of the Day
children.summary: The start of the winter heating season in Europe typically sees withdrawals from storage facilities ramp up sharply. The higher than normal temperatures so far have delayed the start to sizeable draws.
